title: Cancer-associated fibroblast-derived fibulin-5 promotes epithelial-mesenchymal transition in diffuse-type gastric cancer via cAMP response element-binding protein pathway, showing poor prognosis.
authors: Choi, Jinju; Kwak, Yoonjin; Park, Miree; Jo, Jeong Yeon; Kang, Jun Hyuk; Myeong-Cherl, Kook; Kim, Hang-Rae; Kim, Gwanghun; Kong, Seong-Ho; Park, Do-Joong; Lee, Hye Seung; Lee, Hyuk-Joon; Kim, Jung Mogg; Kim, Sang Gyun; Yang, Han-Kwang; Ryu, Ji Kon; Cho, Soo-Jeong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究癌症相关成纤维细胞分泌的fibulin-5通过CREB通路促进弥漫型胃癌上皮间质转化，属于纯肿瘤生物学与临床预后研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟建模方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diffuse-type gastric cancer (DGC), characterized by poorly cohesive cells within fibrotic stroma, is associated with advanced disease and poor prognosis. Here, to identify distinct biomarkers for DGC compared with intestinal-type gastric cancer, we constructed a comprehensive large-scale signaling network using RNA-sequencing data from three genomic databases (The Cancer Genome Atlas, GSE62254 and GSE26253), developed a mathematical model and conducted simulation analyses. For validation, we used tissue microarray blocks of gastric cancers with immunohistochemical staining, single-cell RNA sequencing, primary cultures of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) and organoids, and a co-culture system involving CAFs and cancer cells. Signaling network analysis identified six differentially activated signaling components across the database, including BIRC5, TTK, NEK2, FHL1, NR2F1 and FBLN5. Among the differentially activated signaling components, high tumoral expression of fibulin-5 protein encoded by FBLN5 correlated with poor overall and disease-specific survival rates in patients with DGC, even after adjusting for the tumor, node, metastases (TNM) stage. Fibulin-5, derived from CAFs within DGC stroma, promoted organoid growth and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in DGC cell lines via the cAMP response element-binding protein (CREB) pathway in a CAF co-culture system. FBLN5 knockdown in CAFs reduced the aggressive phenotype of co-cultured DGC cells, while CREB inhibitors reversed EMT. Furthermore, levels of secreted FBLN5 in patient blood samples correlated with its expression in primary tumors. In summary, fibulin-5 secreted by CAFs and interacted with DGC cells promotes EMT and is clinically associated with poor patient outcomes. These findings suggest fibulin-5 as a potential prognostic marker and therapeutic target in patients with DGC.
abstract_zh: 弥漫型胃癌（DGC）以纤维化间质内低黏附性细胞为特征，与疾病进展和不良预后相关。在此，为识别与肠型胃癌相比DGC的特异性生物标志物，我们利用三个基因组数据库（The Cancer Genome Atlas、GSE62254和GSE26253）的RNA测序数据构建了一个全面的大规模信号网络，开发了数学模型并进行了模拟分析。为验证结果，我们使用了胃癌组织微阵列芯片并进行免疫组织化学染色、单细胞RNA测序、癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）和类器官的原代培养，以及涉及CAFs和癌细胞的共培养系统。信号网络分析识别出数据库中六个差异激活的信号组分，包括BIRC5、TTK、NEK2、FHL1、NR2F1和FBLN5。在差异激活的信号组分中，由FBLN5编码的fibulin-5蛋白的高肿瘤表达与DGC患者的总生存率和疾病特异性生存率较差相关，即使在调整肿瘤、淋巴结、转移（TNM）分期后仍如此。DGC间质中CAFs来源的fibulin-5通过cAMP反应元件结合蛋白（CREB）通路在CAF共培养系统中促进DGC细胞系的类器官生长和上皮-间质转化（EMT）。CAFs中FBLN5敲低减少了共培养DGC细胞的侵袭性表型，而CREB抑制剂逆转了EMT。此外，患者血液样本中分泌型FBLN5的水平与其原发肿瘤中的表达相关。总之，CAFs分泌的fibulin-5与DGC细胞相互作用，促进EMT，并在临床上与患者不良结局相关。这些发现提示fibulin-5可能作为DGC患者的潜在预后标志物和治疗靶点。
